_meta.no_deed_text: No Deed Book Found or Provided
_meta.deed_formats: Wisconsin registers of deeds index by document number, older records by volume and page. Seen: plain document numbers (Adams "578006", Fond du Lac "1179669", Calumet "592350"), year-R numbers (Bayfield "2021R-592207", Wood "2020R01826"), volume-page (Fond du Lac "1053-580", Bayfield VPDOC "378-62", Wood "V0827P0304", Sauk "260/499"), separate Volume / Page fields (Adams VOL_NO/PAGE_NO, Juneau Volume_1/Page_1, Bayfield Vol/Pg), lists of every document on the parcel (Sauk DOCUMENTS, Wood DOCREF, Jefferson VOLPG1), and an HTML document table (Washington DocumentInfo).
_meta.plat_formats: No plat book/page field selected (some layers have plat names or plat codes only).
_meta.excluded_false_hits: St. Croix: City of Hudson ArcGIS Online copy St_Croix_County_Parcels (V-schema, edit 2026-04-07) is a city-held copy; the statewide V12 layer is used instead.; Langlade: Langlade_County_Parcels in an Antigo consultant account (V-schema, edit 2025-06-25) is older than V12; the statewide V12 layer is used.; Jackson: Jackson County items in an outside account are a test layer (TaxParcelTest_Public) and county-owned parcels only; the statewide V12 layer is used.; Richland: V1200_Wisconsin_Parcels_RICHLAND (outside account) is the same V12 data; the statewide V12 layer is used.; Taylor: V1200_Wisconsin_Parcels_Taylor_Copy_gdb is a consultant copy of V12; the statewide V12 layer is used.; Crawford: Crawford_County_Parcels_Copy_gdb (consultant copy, 2023) is older than V12; the statewide V12 layer is used.; Marathon: Parcels_2026_View_Only (outside account, CoParcels_01022026) has only 2,522 parcels vs 83,708 in V12; owner MAIL_NAME1, deed VOL_PAGE1: https://services6.arcgis.com/U8aLV7JhWlzvq2FB/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels_2026_View_Only/FeatureServer/0; Eau Claire: Eau Claire County BaseLayers/Tax_Parcel layer 0 has 28,284 parcels vs 52,015 in V12 (City of Eau Claire parcels not in it); owner is FirstName/LastName (the Name field is the parcel number); DocHistory document field: https://gis.eauclairecounty.gov/agsserver/rest/services/BaseLayers/Tax_Parcel/FeatureServer/0; Rock: Rock County TaxParcels/Tax_Parcel_Layer layer 26 has 39,697 features (35,309 with owner) vs 73,143 in V12 (Janesville and Beloit city parcels not in it); owner LAST_NAME/FIRST_NAME, deed DOCUMENT and VOL1/PAGE1: https://rockgis.co.rock.wi.us/rockpub/rest/services/TaxParcels/Tax_Parcel_Layer/MapServer/26
